# Safety paths: the machinery the routines run on. A change here is the human's to merge, however small:
# auto-merge blocks the PR and triage scores the issue risk:high. Both read this file through
# `make-routines/scripts/routines.sh safety`, so edit the list here, never in a prompt.
# One bash glob per line, matched against "/<path>": a leading / anchors at the repo root, */ matches at any
# depth, and * crosses directories. Text after the glob is a comment.
/.github/*          the routines, their prompts, this list, and CI
*/.flow/*           gitignored, so a PR that adds one forces it in: ready.sh runs its commands and reads its hook switches
*/.claude/*         gitignored too: forced-in skills, agents or commands load into every later run
*/CLAUDE.md
*/AGENTS.md
*/.mcp.json
*/settings*.json
*/.claude-plugin/*
/plugins/flow-stack/hooks/*
/plugins/flow-stack/agents/*
/plugins/flow-stack/templates/*
/README.md                                  the rules the review and self-heal routines read
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/principles/*     the rules the review and self-heal routines read
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/flow/*
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/review/*
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/verify/*
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/seal/*
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/gate/*
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/make-gates/*
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/make-routines/*
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/*/scripts/*      hooks and the ready bar run these (setup/scripts/inventory.sh at every session start, feature-map/scripts/features.sh from ready.sh), so a change runs inside every later routine that holds write tokens
